name: Agent Failure Autopsy
buyer_input: One failure sentence, the coding harness or stack name, and one or more redacted transcript, log, or screenshot artifacts inside the intake boundary.
deliverable: An evidence-linked timeline and failure chain, primary and contributing causes with calibrated confidence, adversarial challenge, concrete fix steps only where evidence supports them, and one replay or regression-prevention check.
acceptance: the buyer failure sentence is reproduced exactly
each causal explanation is adversarially challenged
delivery stays inside the recorded one-business-day window or refunds
no code implementation or production access is claimed
refund: Refund USD 29 when accepted artifacts cannot support a defensible diagnosis after the included clarification, when a legitimate one-run case cannot fit the intake boundary, when quarantined evidence remains unusable, when a seemingly usable case does not survive adversarial review, or when a defensible diagnosis cannot be delivered within the recorded one-business-day window.
